info.name: MSX-Pico
info.description: MSX-Pico+ cartridge firmware running as a host library (emsxpico). Put libmsxpico.dylib and flash.img next to this file, or edit the paths below. Add <library2> (the FM firmware) to let the menu's <INS> switch between them, and <fm>true</fm> to start on it. <sd> names the SD card's image, a FAT16 disk image the firmware reads and writes.
